findings.reason: The first implementation selected the injected clock by truthiness, so a callable with a false boolean value silently fell back to the system monotonic clock. A focused red regression reproduced it; explicit None selection now preserves every callable clock.

The first candidate accepted checkpoint rows whose step limit exceeded the task limit or whose step elapsed exceeded task elapsed. Fresh-context review reproduced both impossible records; red regressions were added and the constructor/restore validator now rejects either contradiction.

The first fix's regression cases could remain green through unrelated active-step or elapsed-time validation. The final tests isolate each rule with otherwise valid records and exact rejection reasons; in-memory guard-removal checks proved removing either production guard makes its matching test fail.

Completed independent fresh-context reviews covered the full candidate and then the corrected new diff. The final review returned no blocker or major finding and accepted the discriminating regression tests.
